raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "7.3.0"
  root_version_spec: ">=6.40.00"

package:
  name: fastframes
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  # A sha256 mismatch here is usually GitLab, not a wrong checksum: it sends the
  # 200 header before generating this 341 MB archive, so CI jobs hitting it cold
  # and all at once can each get an empty body (gitlab-org/gitlab#471955).
  # Re-run them; fetching the tarball once by hand first warms GitLab's cache.
  url: https://gitlab.cern.ch/atlas-amglab/fastframes/-/archive/v${{ version }}/fastframes-v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 2a710b8d720a1c5fc709bbab1534499d403cf039fb239a576ce4a297f22adb04
  patches:
    - install-python-files.patch
    - import-extensions-from-package.patch
    # Fixed upstream; drop once a release includes it
    - merge-jobs-stdlib-dataclass.patch

build:
  number: 0
  skip:
    - win
  script:
    - cmake ${CMAKE_ARGS} -DPython3_EXECUTABLE=$PYTHON -DPython3_INCLUDE_DIR=$PREFIX/include/python${PY_VER} -DFASTFRAMES_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=$SP_DIR -DONNXRUNTIME_INCLUDE_DIRS=$PREFIX/include/onnxruntime -DONNXRUNTIME_LIBRARIES=$PREFIX/lib/libonnxruntime.so -S . -B build
    - cmake --build build --clean-first --parallel="${CPU_COUNT}" --verbose
    - cmake --install build

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cmake
    - make
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - python
        - root_base ${{ root_version_spec }}
        - root_cxx_standard
  host:
    - root_base ${{ root_version_spec }}
    - root_cxx_standard
    - libboost-python-devel
    - python
    - onnxruntime-cpp
  run:
    - python
    - pyyaml

tests:
  - package_contents:
      files:
        - bin/fast-frames.exe
  - script:
      - FastFrames.py -h

about:
  license: BSD-2-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: 'FastFrames: RDataFrames for ATLAS analysis ntuples'
  description: |
    FastFrames is a histogramming and ntuple reprocessing framework developed
    for the ATLAS Experiment. It is built around ROOT's RDataFrame, and is
    easily extendable so users can leverage RDataFrame to compute their
    desired physics observables.
  homepage: https://gitlab.cern.ch/atlas-amglab/fastframes
  repository: https://gitlab.cern.ch/atlas-amglab/fastframes
  documentation: https://atlas-project-topreconstruction.web.cern.ch/fastframesdocumentation/latest/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - p-queue
    - kratsg
